XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic engine noise, oil level warning light on and insufficient oil pressure warning.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | WARNING LIGHT | FAULT | PRESSURE | OIL | RED | RED | ON | ON | NOISE | NOISY | LEVEL | LOW | OIL | DIAPHRAGM | DIAPHRAGM | INSUFFICIENT | PRESSURE | ENGINE | SWITCH OFF | IMMEDIATELY |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Engine oil dipstick

  • Fault: Sporadic abnormal engine vibrations while running, with oil level warning light illuminated. Warning message "Insufficient engine oil pressure, switch off engine immediately" displayed on the screen

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Clogged engine oil dipstick

• Action: Check the condition of the oil dipstick and clean or replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: In this case, the component was replaced and, in order to access it, it was necessary to remove the oil sump, which can be accessed by removing the catalytic converter and the corresponding exhaust manifold.
